design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #F6F0E8; --surface: #FFFDF8; --surface-alt: #E6DDD1; --text: #151515; --muted: #454545; --primary: #0F172A; --accent: #B45309; --on-primary: #FFFFFF; --on-accent: #FFFFFF; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 24px; --gap: 48px; --blur: 22px; --nav-position: fixed; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; } .local-map-panel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr; gap: var(--gap); align-items: stretch; } .area-chip { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; padding: .75rem 1rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, var(--accent)); } .trust-badge { backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent); } body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background-image: radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 18%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 4px 4px; opacity: .035; z-index: 80; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
